title: The Key to Creating Learning Projects You’ll Finish
author: Scott Young
description: My three-step process for self-directed learning projects you'll actually complete. The post The Key to Creating Learning Projects You’ll Finish appeared first on Scott H Young .
summary: How do you craft projects you’ll actually finish? I’ve spent most of my life undertaking learning projects of various sorts.
takeaways: My Strategy for Creating Successful, Short Learning Projects In a recent video essay , I outlined the three-step process I use to design these sorts of short projects to quickly get up to speed in a skill or topic.
By creating a map and understanding how the skill works, we can chart an effective course.
Even if you can’t study full-time, what might you be able to do if you set aside a little time each day to work on a skill or topic you care about?
